blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Financial institutions that seek to issue structured warrants in the Philippines must maintain at least P400 million in unimpaired paid-up capital under new rules from the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The requirement must be met by the issuer or its guarantor for as long as any structured warrants remain outstanding. READ: […]... Keep on reading: SEC sets P400-M capital floor for warrant issuers
